Specializations.Description: The operation that provides background information such as information about the organisation and their climate information needs
Specializations.Name: Provide background information

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides the name of the customer organisation.
Specializations.Name: Provide organization name

Specializations.Description: The operation that describes the type of the customer organisation.
Specializations.Name: Describe organization type

Specializations.Description: The operation that describes the size (e.g. small, medium, large) of the customer organisation.
Specializations.Name: Describe organization size

Specializations.Comment: Can use sectors associated with hazards
Specializations.Description: The operation that describes the operating sector of the customer organisation.
Specializations.Name: Describe organization operating sector

Specializations.Comment: Can be described in one of the text fields regarding the case
Specializations.Description: The operation that quantifies years of experience in using climate data
Specializations.Name: Provide years of experience in using climate data

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides climate case information such as spatial region and planning time range.
Specializations.Name: Provide climate case information

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides a title for the case.
Specializations.Name: Add case title

Specializations.Description: The operation that states the climate-related challenges faced by the organisation or by its operational activities.
Specializations.Name: Define customer needs

Specializations.Description: The operation that states the main goals for which the customer is seeking climate information.
Specializations.Name: Define request goal

Specializations.Description: The operation that sets a deadline (a date in the form MM/YYYY) for climate intelligence provision.
Specializations.Name: Add expected deadline

Specializations.Description: The operation that estimates the required resources (e.g., human, computational, financial).
Specializations.Name: Add required resources

Specializations.Output: Spatial region (custom or predefined cordex domain)
Specializations.Description: The operation that indicates the geographic area of interest.
Specializations.Name: Indicate spatial region

Specializations.Description: The operation that states the overall time horizon over which the climate information is required. If multiple horizons are of interest, provide the time horizon that covers them all. In case such information is not available or not explicitly defined, provide the typical time horizon for organisations' planning decisions.
Specializations.Name: Define planning time horizon

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides decision context information.
Specializations.Name: Provide decision context information

Specializations.Comment: Each case can have one or more climate questions, and that each climate question can be associated to one or more hazards.
Specializations.Description: The operation that formulates key questions related to climate information that the customer seeks to answer.
Specializations.Name: Formulate climate questions

Specializations.Description: The operation that identifies the climate hazards (a climate-related physical event or process) that impact the customer organisation.
Specializations.Name: Identify hazards

Specializations.Description: The operation that describes how climate hazards impact the organisation's activities and the proposed case.
Specializations.Name: Describe climate hazard impacts

Specializations.Description: The operation that lists decisions or actions that could be better informed with improved climate information for the identified hazards.
Specializations.Name: Specify decision context

Specializations.Description: The operation that outlines the organisational standard practices regarding the identified hazards
Specializations.Name: Provide information on organisational standards

Specializations.Description: The operation that identifies the presence of people, assets, resources, or activities in places and settings potentially affected by the identified hazards.
Specializations.Name: Provide information on exposure identification

Specializations.Description: The operation that collects information regarding how susceptible a system, asset or population is to the climate hazards. It reflects lack of capacity to cope with or adapt to impacts. High vulnerability often reduces risk tolerance.
Specializations.Name: Provide information on vulnerability identification

Specializations.Description: The operation that rates risk tolerance, i.e. a measure of the extent to which a user is willing to accept uncertainty and potential adverse outcomes related to climate risks: for example, a low risk tolerance indicates a preference for detailed quantification of even the most extreme climate scenarios, enabling proactive planning and adaptation to minimise potential impacts.
Specializations.Name: Rate risk tolerance

Specializations.Description: The operation that specifies the climate risk framing (e.g., loss probability, combination of hazard, exposure and vulnerability: risk index, etc.)
Specializations.Name: Specify climate risk framing

Description: The operation that requests external expertise such as an expert or literature review.
Name: Search additional information

Specializations.Description: The operation that looks for additional information from existing literature.
Specializations.Name: Perform literature review

Specializations.Description: The operation that requests external expertise from an expert.
Specializations.Name: Search for external expertise

Description: The operation that prepares the climate information.
Name: Prepare climate information

Specializations.Description: The operation that identifies the climate indices (e.g., number of tropical nights per calendar year, standardised precipitation index) or variables (e.g.,  max temperature, monthly rainfall) if no suitable indicator is found relevant to the study or decision-making context.
Specializations.Name: Identify indices and variables

Specializations.Comment: Not always needed - if absolute values are used in output and no comparison to observations are made
Specializations.Description: The operation that chooses a historical reference period (e.g., 1850–1900 as pre-industrial baseline, 1986–2005 in IPCC AR5, 1995–2014 in IPCC AR6) to serve as a baseline for comparing future climate projections or for global warming level extraction
Specializations.Name: Choose baseline period

Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if GWL is not selected
Specializations.Description: The operation that chooses the future time horizons of interest (e.g., specific period in the future like 2080–2100, 2030–2080) for climate information or risk or impact assessment.
Specializations.Name: Choose future period

Specializations.ForwardDependecy: Choose global warming level extraction method
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if future period is not selected
Specializations.Description: The operation that selects specific global warming levels (e.g., +1.5°C, +2°C).
Specializations.Name: Choose global warming level

Specializations.ForwardDependecy: Filter climate simulations by global warming level exceedance
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if task "Global warming level choice" is selected
Specializations.Description: The operation that chooses a method to extract regional climate change data in relation to selected global warming levels above pre-industrial (default: 1850-1900).
Specializations.Name: Choose global warming level extraction method

Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if future period choice is used
Specializations.Description:
The operation that defines appropriate representative concentration pathways (RCPs) or shared socioeconomic
pathways (SSPs) to explore a range of future climate outcomes.
Specializations.Name: Define emission scenarios

Specializations.Description: The operation that selects the required spatial resolution (e.g., 1 km, 60 km, 0.25°) range for the output climate data.
Specializations.Name: Define relevant spatial resolutions

Specializations.Description: The operation that selects the required temporal resolution (e.g., daily, monthly, annual, seasonal) range for the output climate data.
Specializations.Name: Define relevant temporal resolutions

Specializations.Condition: For possible values, see Table 1 of this document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1svoQ4lW1i4nFaPWZEzIxQakPmS_sDS4uO9yy9OmeSQo/edit?tab=t.0
Specializations.Description: The operation that selects a sub-annual period (e.g. month, season, period in year) of interest (e.g. boreal winter (DJFM), austral spring (SON), Januarys, Julys).
Specializations.Name: Define subannual selection

Specializations.Condition: CV would only be "station-based" and "gridded". "station-based" refers to observations collected at a specific geographic point, "gridded" refers to observations interpolated or modelled onto a regular grid of cells. I think it can be related to "GeodeticPoint" and "RegularGrid" respectively.
Specializations.Description: The operation that defines the preferred observation type (e.g., station-based, gridded).
Specializations.Name: Define observation type

Specializations.Output: Access point organisation or country of origin
Specializations.Description: The operation that chooses the preferred source for climate simulation data access (access point: e.g., ESGF datanodes, Copernicus CDS, OpenDAP, national portals).
Specializations.Name: Define preferred access point

Specializations.Output: Additional selection criteria for climate simulations
Specializations.Comment: free text to be possibly parsed and linked. In the description, added a request to provide URIs
Specializations.Description: The operation that provides additional constraints to the climate simulation selection like origin of source (e.g., institution, country of origin), etc. Provide information with URIs taken from the KG where possible.
Specializations.Name: Provide additional climate simulation selection criteria

Specializations.Comment: free text to be possibly parsed and linked. In the description, added a request to provide URIs
Specializations.Description: The operation that provides additional constraints to the observation selection, such as the origin of the source (e.g., institution, country of origin), etc. Provide information with URIs taken from the KG where possible.
Specializations.Name: Provide additional observation selection criteria

Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if case solver decides not to manually select the climate simulations or use impact models instead
Specializations.Description: The operation that applies filtering criteria to the list of climate simulations and shortlisting matching entries.
Specializations.Name: Filter climate simulations by selection criteria

Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if case solver decides not to manually select the observations
Specializations.Description: The operation that applies filtering criteria to the list of observations and shortlisting matching entries.
Specializations.Name: Filter observations by selection criteria

Specializations.BackwardDependency: Filter climate simulations by selection criteria
Specializations.Description: The operation that selects the climate simulations
Specializations.Name: Conduct manual selection of climate simulations

Specializations.Description: The operation that selects the observations
Specializations.Name: Conduct manual selection of observations

Specializations.Input: GWL range; GWL extraction method; if scenario-based, emission scenario definition
Specializations.Output: List of climate simulations (with associated global warming exceeding selected GWL)
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if task "Global warming level choice" is selected and "Global warming level extraction method" is not "Pattern scaling"
Specializations.Comment: Simulations need to be retrieved at this stage to do this - but only GCMs, not RCMs
Specializations.Description: The operation that selects simulations exceeding the specific global warming level.
Specializations.Name: Filter climate simulations by global warming level exceedance

Specializations.Input: List of climate simulations (with associated global warming exceeding selected GWL)
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if "Global warming level extraction method" is "Time slice"
Specializations.Description: The operation that extractes the time slice centered around the point in time when the specific global warming level is exceeded.
Specializations.Name: Extract global warming level time slice

Specializations.BackwardDependency: Conduct manual selection of climate simulations
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if "Global warming level extraction method" is "Pattern scaling"
Specializations.Comment: Requires simulation (and observation, if used) retrieval
Specializations.Description: The operation that conducts pattern scaling of regional climate response to the global warming level.
Specializations.Name: Apply pattern scaling

Specializations.Comment: Requires simulation retrieval - I see an issue with I/O as "Climate simulations" are not defined before.
Specializations.Description: The operation that applies statistical or dynamical downscaling techniques to increase the spatial resolution of global or regional climate model outputs. This task is normally unnecessary if the selected data is already downscaled.
Specializations.Name: Apply additional spatial downscaling

Specializations.Input: Raw observations, raw or downscaled climate simulations, or pattern-scaled climate data
Specializations.Output: Processed climate data - processed observations, processed climate simulations
Specializations.Comment:
Requires simulation and observation retrieval (unless downscaled or pattern-scaled data are used).
Can apply no methods, but must be conducted to ensure consistency
Specializations.Description: The operation that performs data preprocessing (e.g., regridding, gap-filling, aggregation, filtering, bias correction) on raw climate model output and observations to ensure it is accurate, consistent, and suitable for analysis.
Specializations.Name: Apply data preprocessing

Specializations.Input: Processed climate data, selected index definitions
Specializations.Output: Calculated indices for observations and climate simulations
Specializations.Description: The operation that computes relevant climate indices from both observational and climate model datasets. Possibly, emulators could be used to obtain relevant information for index computation.
Specializations.Name: Compute climate indices

Specializations.Description: The operation that analyzes observational datasets to establish historical trends and variability.
Specializations.Name: Conduct observation analysis

Specializations.Description: The operation that aggregates calculated indices.
Specializations.Name: Conduct spatial aggregation

Specializations.BackwardDependency: Filter climate simulations by selection criteria
Specializations.Input: Calculated or aggregated indices, or processed climate data, or observation analysis
Specializations.Condition: Obligatory unless case solver decides to only use impact models (like ISIMIP) without input data from climate simulations
Specializations.Comment: We require case solver to add at least some type of quality evaluation metric - regardless it is used to make the final decision or not.
Specializations.Description: The operation that evaluates the performance of climate simulations against observations, by comparing how well climate models reproduce historical climate conditions for selected indices or variables. This evaluation helps determine which models could be more reliable for projecting future climate changes.
Specializations.Name: Evaluate climate simulations

Specializations.Condition: Obligatory if "Climate simulation evaluation" is conducted
Specializations.Description: The operation that rejects the climate model simulations that do not meet the evaluation criteria or the ad hoc selection by the case solver.
Specializations.Name: Select climate simulations

Condition: If not pursued, climate impact assessment is obligatory
Description: The operation that analyses the climate information to understand what future climatic changes are simulated and associated uncertainties.
Name: Analyse climate information

Specializations.Description: The operation that analyses and projecting the future climate by creating an output metric based on the selected climate simulations.
Specializations.Name: Quantify future climate change

Specializations.Description: The operation that quantifies the uncertainty in projections of the selected climate simulations.
Specializations.Name: Quantify uncertainty

Specializations.Description: The operation that indicates the subjective level of confidence in future climate change and uncertainty quantification.
Specializations.Name: Estimate subjective confidence

Specializations.Description: The operation that postprocesses (e.g., spatially aggregating) provided climate information
Specializations.Name: Postprocess climate information

Condition: Only obligatory if climate information analysis is not done.
Description: The operation that conducts the climate impact assessment to understand the impacts of each hazard
Name: Assess climate impacts

Specializations.Input: Aggregated climate information or output metric and uncertainty estimate, impact assessment method
Specializations.Description: The operation that identifies models, transfer functions or datasets that can translate climate information into an impact assesment
Specializations.Name: Select impact model

Specializations.Input: Aggregated climate information or output metric and uncertainty estimate, impact assessment method
Specializations.Description: The operation that applies impact models, transfer functions or datasets to simulate, quantify, or describe the impacts
Specializations.Name: Conduct impact analysis

Specializations.Description: The operation that postprocesses the provided climate impact information (e.g., spatial aggregation, regridding) as necessary
Specializations.Name: Postprocess impact analysis

Description: The operation that conducts climate risk assessment.
Name: Conduct climate risk assessment

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides vulnerability information.
Specializations.Name: Identify vulnerability

Specializations.Description: The operation that provides exposure information.
Specializations.Name: Identify exposure

Specializations.Input: Impact analysis OR postprocessed impact analysis, vulnerability & exposure information
Specializations.Description: The operation that conducts the climate risk assessment.
Specializations.Name: Assess risk
